reason: C is the adoption candidate: it is the union of the two layers that have each moved a cell, plus the one discipline the db-wal cell needs. It carries rev-3 A (four-fifths deadline, a real answer instead of a placeholder, the standard tool instead of a hand-rolled substitute, read the deliverable back), rev-3 B (run the checks that grade each requirement, cover the values the new construct does not create itself, match the exact strings and classifications), and one added rule: copy the task's input data before any command that could write to it. Five cells, same composition, single delta (the C prefix text).

evidenceBasis.gcodeDelivery: Four arms never wrote /app/out.txt; rev-2 A wrote a literal placeholder and submitted it. The run's budget is cut at the reserved boundary (~719.8s of 900s), so a late conversion never happens.
evidenceBasis.exprSurvivor: A arms fail six checks, B arms fail one (ErrtypeTypeError). Both families are behaviors on values handed in from outside the model's own code.
evidenceBasis.guards: largest-eigenval and sqlite-db-truncate passed under the no-prefix control in this composition; they are carried as regression detectors, single-attempt reading only.

gainDefinition.primary: gcode-to-text reaches passed, or expr-try-catch-errors reaches 79/79 f2p - neither has happened in any measured arm. As the adoption candidate it is also required not to regress: both guard cells must still pass.
gainDefinition.partial: db-wal-recovery keeps its input and produces WAL-complete values (the previous best non-network attempt wrote the base values, assert 100 == 150), or gcode-to-text leaves a real candidate string, or the expr failing set shrinks below one check.
gainDefinition.noRegression: Both guard cells still pass and every predeclared cell keeps a real verdict with the acceptance block intact.
gainDefinition.note: If C shows no gain over A or B alone, the extra rule is not credited; if it shows the only gain, the three parts are still one text and a follow-up arm would have to split them to attribute it.

constraints: Exactly one predeclared headless attempt per listed cell, nothing else.

Five cells: three targets (db-wal-recovery, gcode-to-text, expr-try-catch-errors) and two guards (largest-eigenval, sqlite-db-truncate) that passed under the no-prefix control; the guards exist to detect a prefix regression and are not targets.
No verdict of run 37004410693 or of any earlier run is replaced, refilled or reinterpreted; this arm exists only as a same-composition measurement with a single prompt-prefix delta.
The result is never merged into any pass@1; run 37004410693 keeps its own frozen verdicts and passAt1=0.6.
Budgets, effort, grader, execution profile and per-call ceiling are exactly the frozen composition's.
Nothing is published to main; the manifest lives on fh/usage-accounting-proof.
readingBoundary: The comparison of interest is rev-3 C against the no-prefix control (five cells) and against A-rev3 / B-rev3 on the cells each layer targets. C is a union text, so a gain is attributed to the union, not to one clause; a split follow-up would be the only way to attribute it. Single attempts cannot separate wording from route variance.
plannedChecks: After the report artifact is downloaded: disposition/rewards/durationMs per cell; whether the db-wal attempt kept its input (what the first sqlite3 probe did, whether a copy existed) and what values it wrote; whether /app/out.txt exists with a real candidate; the expr failing set; both guards; the acceptance block.
